drift_points.actual: When the envvar is defined but unset, Parameter.resolve_envvar_value returns None, so consume_value does not fall back to get_default and the option prompts instead
consume_value passes the None it received from value_from_envvar into type_cast_value, bypassing the default that get_default would supply

required_files.rationale: Parameter.resolve_envvar_value, value_from_envvar, consume_value, get_default, and type_cast_value methods implement the parameter source resolution chain
ParamType classes that handle conversion during resolution

sufficient_files.rationale: option() decorator that configures envvar and default parameters
